name: rush_hour_benchmark_320_13_21
description: A benchmark of Rush Hour sliding-block puzzles intended for evaluating planning / RL agents on puzzle-solving and trajectory generation. It measures whether agents can solve instances (reach the goal vehicle exit) and commonly reports solve rates and solution lengths across a set of puzzle instances of varying difficulty.
reputation: A niche/experimental benchmark used primarily in RL/planning research for evaluating solvers on Rush Hour puzzles; modest adoption.
